literal: A rare secret letting-slip knowledge-lacking-person will-do great-harm himself-indeed to-himself.
translation: The ignorant man who lets a precious secret slip causes great harm to himself.
modern: அரிய ரகசியங்களை வெளியில் சொல்லிவிடும் அறிவில்லாதவன், தனக்குத் தானே பெரும் துன்பத்தை உண்டாக்கிக் கொள்வான்.
explanation: This couplet describes the self-destructive behavior of an ignorant person. Such a person lacks the discretion to guard valuable or confidential information, represented here as 'அருமறை' (precious secret), and carelessly lets it slip out ('சோரும்'). By revealing what should be kept hidden, he brings immense trouble and ruin ('பெருமிறை') upon himself. The phrase 'தானே தனக்கு' emphasizes that the fool does not need an external enemy to destroy him; his own lack of wisdom is entirely sufficient to cause his downfall.
